user.title: State Duration Tracker
user.description: This creates the State Duration Tracker service. Afterwards use **Add tracker** on the integration page to track an entity, and the cog next to a tracker to change it.

abort.single_instance_allowed: State Duration Tracker is already set up. Add trackers from its integration page.

user.title: Track state duration
user.description: Pick the entity whose state durations you want to track.

states.title: States to track
states.description: Choose which states of `{entity_id}` to track. `unknown` and `unavailable` are always ignored and never reset a timer. You can also type custom states.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: All optional. The 'Current state duration' sensor is always created. The alert creates a binary sensor that turns on when the entity stays in a state for too long.

data_description.since_sensor: Adds a timestamp sensor showing when the current state started.
data_description.per_state_sensors: Adds one duration sensor for each tracked state (0 while in another state).
data_description.daily_stats: Adds 'time today' and 'count today' sensors for each tracked state.
data_description.update_interval: How often duration sensors refresh. Higher values write less to the database.
data_description.alert_minutes: Turn the alert on after this many minutes.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure tracker
reconfigure.description: Settings for `{entity_id}`. Sensors for removed states are deleted.

data_description.since_sensor: Adds a timestamp sensor showing when the current state started.
data_description.per_state_sensors: Adds one duration sensor for each tracked state (0 while in another state).
data_description.daily_stats: Adds 'time today' and 'count today' sensors for each tracked state.
data_description.update_interval: How often duration sensors refresh. Higher values write less to the database.
data_description.alert_state: State to watch, e.g. Open. Leave empty to disable.
data_description.alert_minutes: Turn the alert on after this many minutes.

error.no_states: Select at least one state to track.
error.alert_incomplete: Set both the alert state and the alert minutes, or leave both empty.
error.alert_state_not_tracked: The alert state must be one of the tracked states.
